pairs.source_Chinese: 按用途指定模型时，下拉只能选中可以用在这一处的模型。默认模型的候选里有、但不能用在这一处的模型列在下拉末尾，写明原因，例如「不接受首帧」「不接受参考图」，不能选中。停用和已下线的模型不在其中。

pairs.after_English:
When choosing a model for a specific purpose, the dropdown only allows models usable there. Models present among the default-model candidates but unusable for that purpose appear at the end of the dropdown with a reason, such as "Does not accept a first frame" or "Does not accept reference images", and cannot be selected. Disabled and discontinued models are not included.

- Turning off a model's switch disables it immediately:

pairs.source_Chinese:
- 所有模型都显示「这个供应商支持的参数」，即生效的能力与数值：模型目录的记录与调用端点支持范围都满足的部分，数量上限取两者中较小的那个。
  两侧都没有记录的数值显示「未收录」，表示 ArcReel 没有收录这项限制，不代表可以随意传入，超出部分由供应商拒绝。
  图片模型的参考图上限为 0 时不接受参考图，图生图同时显示为不支持，不会出现在图生图的候选里；
- 官方收录的内置模型在「供应商设置」里只能启用或停用，「这个供应商支持的参数」只能查看，由官方维护；「模型信息」的修改见下文；
pairs.before_English: - Officially listed built-in models can only be enabled or disabled; their other settings are maintained officially;

pairs.source_Chinese:
- 修改「这个供应商支持的参数」：供应商实际支持的参数与模型信息不同时在这里修改，比如中转站只开放部分时长或分辨率，
    或者不支持尾帧。每一项显示原值，点「修改」后整项替换，点「恢复」回到原值。对应不上已知模型的模型也可以修改。
    图片模型可以修改「参考图上限」，整项替换模型信息与调用端点共同算出的上限；填 0 表示不接受参考图，点「恢复」回到原值。调用端点须实现图生图，修改上限才能用于这条路径。
    视频模型的「按分辨率限定时长」跟在「可选时长」后面，删掉某个分辨率时，
    它的时长限定一并删除；

- 在内置供应商下自己添加的模型另有「调用端点」，可选项只有这个供应商的调用端点，添加时按模型名称预填。
  例如 MiniMax 的视频模型可以在「MiniMax Hailuo V1」「MiniMax Hailuo V1 Fast」「MiniMax S2V-01」与「MiniMax H3」之间选择。
  更换后「这个供应商支持的参数」里的修改随之清除，保存后再按新的调用端点修改；
pairs.before_English: - Models of custom providers also have "Set as default", "Call endpoint", "Request URL", and a default resolution.
pairs.after_English:
- Models you added yourself under a built-in provider also have a "Call endpoint" field, offering only that provider's endpoints and prefilled from the model name when added.
  For example, MiniMax video models can choose between "MiniMax Hailuo V1", "MiniMax Hailuo V1 Fast", "MiniMax S2V-01", and "MiniMax H3".
  Changing it clears changes under "Parameters this provider supports"; save first, then adjust them for the new endpoint;
- Models of custom providers also have "Set as default", "Call endpoint", "Request URL", and a default resolution.

pairs.after_English:
After adding, the new model's settings open right away so you can adjust its call endpoint and other settings.

Keep a built-in provider model's call endpoint unchanged until video tasks submitted before the upgrade finish. Older tasks did not record endpoint identity, so changing the endpoint may make resumption fail, but never resubmits generation.

"Fetch models"

pairs.source_Chinese: 视频模型的文生视频、首尾帧、参考图和参考音频，取模型目录的记录与调用端点支持范围都满足的部分，参考图与参考音频的数量上限取两者中较小的那个。对应不上已知模型的视频模型，文生视频和首帧按调用端点的支持范围，尾帧和参考音频不可用，参考图数量只受调用端点限制。图片模型能否用于文生图和图生图同样取两侧都满足的部分，参考图上限取两者中较小的那个；对应不上已知模型时，按调用端点的支持范围。需要不同的值时，在[模型设置](#model-settings)里修改「这个供应商支持的参数」，或把模型对应到模型目录中的已知模型。ComfyUI 调用端点例外：输入能力只由 workflow 的节点绑定决定，不读模型目录，也不能在模型设置里修改，见[接入 ComfyUI workflow](./comfyui.md)。
pairs.before_English: Each video call endpoint decides first/last frame, reference image, and reference audio support from the model name. When the name maps to a known model in the model catalog, the endpoint uses that model's official name and aliases. A video model the endpoint does not recognize supports only text-to-video and first-frame generation; last frame, reference images, and reference audio are unavailable. For image models, text-to-image and image-to-image are available only where both the model catalog entry and the call endpoint support them; a model that maps to no known model follows the call endpoint alone.
pairs.after_English: For video models, text-to-video, first/last frames, reference images, and reference audio are supported only where both the model catalog record and the call endpoint support them; reference image and reference audio count limits take the smaller of the two. For video models that do not map to a known model, text-to-video and first-frame support follow the endpoint; last frames and reference audio are unavailable, and reference image counts are limited only by the endpoint. Image models likewise support text-to-image and image-to-image only where both sides do, with the reference image limit taking the smaller value; unmapped models follow the endpoint. To use different values, change "Parameters this provider supports" in [model settings](#model-settings), or map the model to a known catalog entry. ComfyUI endpoints are an exception: input capabilities derive only from workflow node bindings, do not read the catalog, and cannot be changed in model settings; see [Connect a ComfyUI Workflow](./comfyui.md).

pairs.source_Chinese: 通过自定义供应商接入火山方舟 Seedream 时，3.x 选择「Seedream (1K)」，4.x 及后续代际选择「Seedream (2K)」。名称含 `seedream-3` 的模型预填 1K 端点，其余名称含 `seedream` 的模型预填 2K 端点；内置方舟与方舟 Agent Plan 下自己添加的模型也可选择这两个端点。端点决定未指定分辨率时使用的尺寸表，显式指定的分辨率仍原样发送。文生图与带参考图生成复用同一份参考图处理和计量。各模型的具体限制见方舟官方[图片生成 API 文档](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1666946)。升级时，已有模型按此前的请求约定自动设置端点；已保存为「OpenAI 图片」的 Seedream 模型保持原选择。若供应商不支持当前的参考图接口，按提示在[模型设置](#model-settings)里选择对应的 Seedream 端点后重试。
pairs.before_English: To use Volcengine Ark Seedream through a custom provider, use the "Volcengine Ark (Seedream)" call endpoint. Models whose names contain `seedream` are inferred to this endpoint by default. Both text-to-image and generation with reference images reuse the preset Volcengine Ark provider's reference image handling, size calculation, and usage metering. See the official [Image Generation API documentation](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1666946) for each model's limits. Seedream models saved with "OpenAI Images API" keep their selected endpoint. If the provider does not support the current reference image interface, the failed generation prompts you to change the endpoint. Select "Volcengine Ark (Seedream)" in [model settings](#model-settings) and try again.
pairs.after_English: To use Volcengine Ark Seedream through a custom provider, choose "Seedream (1K)" for 3.x and "Seedream (2K)" for 4.x and later generations. Names containing `seedream-3` are prefilled with the 1K endpoint; other names containing `seedream` use the 2K endpoint. Models you add under built-in Ark or Ark Agent Plan can also choose these two endpoints. The endpoint determines the size table used when no resolution is specified; explicitly specified resolutions are still sent unchanged. Text-to-image and generation with reference images share the same reference-image handling and metering. See the official [Image Generation API documentation](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/82379/1666946) for each model's limits. During upgrades, existing models receive endpoints automatically according to their previous request conventions; Seedream models saved with "OpenAI Images API" retain that selection. If the provider does not support the current reference-image interface, follow the notice to select the corresponding Seedream endpoint in [model settings](#model-settings) and retry.

pairs.source_Chinese:
阿里百炼图片的调用端点区分「Qwen 融合」「Qwen 编辑」与「Wan」，分别按总像素预算、单边像素限制与 Wan 的默认尺寸计算请求。模型可选分辨率来自模型目录；Wan 带参考图时最高使用 2K。Agnes 图片的调用端点区分「像素尺寸」与「档位与比例」：前者发送宽高，后者分别发送分辨率档位和画面比例，按各自请求格式计量。已有模型升级后保持此前的请求约定；自行添加模型时按名称预填，也可在模型设置里修改。

通过自定义供应商接入火山方舟 Seedance 时，按模型的代际选择调用端点「火山方舟 (Seedance 1.x)」「火山方舟 (Seedance 2.0)」或「火山方舟 (Seedance 2.5)」，在内置火山方舟与方舟 Agent Plan 下自己添加的模型同样在这三个端点中选择。三个端点调用同一个接口，区别在请求参数与计费：

- 1.x 发送服务档参数，按服务档计费；
- 2.0 与 2.5 不发送服务档参数，提交前按视频 token 预估费用，两者的分辨率与像素对照不同；
- 2.5 带首帧时，画面比例交给供应商按首帧自适应。

名称写明 2.0 或 2.5 的模型默认推断到对应端点，其余名称含 `seedance` 的模型推断到 1.x。模型 ID 不带代际时（例如方舟推理接入点 ID），在[模型设置](#model-settings)里改为对应的端点。已添加的模型在升级时按此前实际使用的代际自动设置，升级前提交的视频任务照常续跑。

内置 Agnes 下自己添加的视频模型，按模型代际选择「Agnes（视频 2.0）」或「Agnes（视频 2.5）」：2.0 输出无声视频，2.5 输出有声视频。分辨率限制来自模型目录条目，不根据型号名中的 `flash` 判断。

百炼异步视频按请求方式分为通用视频、固定有声视频、参考生视频、参考图配音视频和 Wan3 视频。参考生视频必须带参考图；参考图配音把音频逐项绑定到参考图；Wan3 可以切换音轨，并可使用单独的 MaaS 接口地址。添加模型时按名称预填，在[模型设置](#model-settings)里可以修改。已有模型在升级时按此前使用的请求方式自动设置，升级前提交的任务可以继续取回结果。

Veo 的音轨开关由调用方式决定：AI Studio 固定有声，Vertex AI 可以切换音轨。Gemini Omni 经 Interactions API 调用，在 AI Studio 与 Vertex AI 下对应调用端点「Gemini 视频 (Omni)」与「Vertex AI 视频 (Omni)」，Veo 仍是两者的默认调用端点。Omni 的成片固定有声，只能在提示词里描述想要的声音；首尾帧与参考图不能同时使用，也不能单独使用尾帧。自己添加的模型名称含 `gemini-omni` 时预填 Omni 端点，包含 `gemini-omni-1.2-*`。自定义供应商也可选择「Gemini 视频 (Omni)」，使用 API Key 连接兼容 Interactions API 的服务，并分别覆盖提交与轮询路径；Vertex AI 版仍只供内置供应商使用。Sora 是否支持 1080p 由模型目录条目的分辨率决定，不根据型号名中的 `pro` 判断。

可灵视频有两套请求格式。旧版 API 在参数里指定型号，按尾帧与音轨的请求约定分为四个调用端点；新版 API 把型号名写在请求路径里，对应调用端点「Kling 视频（新版 API，固定有声）」，用于 kling-4.0、kling-4.0-flash、kling-3.0-turbo 这类只在新版 API 上提供的型号。新版 API 只支持 API Key 鉴权，内置可灵只填写了 Access Key 与 Secret Key 时无法使用这个端点。这个端点的成片固定有声，没有音轨开关；目前支持文生视频和首尾帧，不支持参考图与参考视频。添加名称为上述型号的模型时，会预填这个端点。
pairs.before_English: If someone has already adapted the call endpoint you need, you can install it directly from the [Market](./market.md) instead of writing the definition yourself.
pairs.after_English:
DashScope image endpoints distinguish "Qwen Fusion", "Qwen Edit", and "Wan", calculating requests from a total pixel budget, a per-side pixel limit, and Wan default sizes respectively. Selectable resolutions come from the model catalog; Wan uses at most 2K with reference images. Agnes image endpoints distinguish "Pixel dimensions" from "Resolution tier and aspect ratio": the former sends width and height, while the latter sends the resolution tier and aspect ratio separately, with metering following each request format. Existing models preserve their previous request conventions after upgrades; manually added models are prefilled by name and can be changed in model settings.

When using Volcengine Ark Seedance through a custom provider, choose "Volcengine Ark (Seedance 1.x)", "Volcengine Ark (Seedance 2.0)", or "Volcengine Ark (Seedance 2.5)" according to the model generation. Models you add under built-in Volcengine Ark or Ark Agent Plan use the same three choices. All three endpoints call the same API, but differ in request parameters and billing:

- 1.x sends a service-tier parameter and is billed by service tier;
- 2.0 and 2.5 do not send a service-tier parameter and estimate costs from video tokens before submission; they have different resolution-to-pixel mappings;
- With a first frame, 2.5 leaves aspect ratio adaptation to the provider based on that frame.

Names explicitly containing 2.0 or 2.5 default to the corresponding endpoint; other names containing `seedance` infer 1.x. For model IDs without a generation (such as Ark inference endpoint IDs), select the corresponding endpoint in [model settings](#model-settings). During upgrades, existing models receive endpoints automatically according to the generation actually used before; video tasks submitted before the upgrade resume normally.

For video models you add under built-in Agnes, choose "Agnes (Video 2.0)" or "Agnes (Video 2.5)" by generation: 2.0 produces silent video and 2.5 produces video with audio. Resolution limits come from the model catalog entry, not from `flash` in the model name.

DashScope asynchronous video endpoints distinguish general video, fixed-audio video, reference-to-video, reference-image audio binding, and Wan3 by request format. Reference-to-video requires reference images; reference-image audio binding attaches each audio item to a reference image; Wan3 supports switching the audio track and a separate MaaS base URL. Models are prefilled by name when added and can be changed in [model settings](#model-settings). Existing models receive endpoints automatically on upgrade according to their previous request format; results of tasks submitted before the upgrade remain retrievable.

Veo audio switching depends on the invocation route: AI Studio always has audio, while Vertex AI supports switching it. Gemini Omni uses the Interactions API, with "Gemini Video (Omni)" under AI Studio and "Vertex AI Video (Omni)" under Vertex AI; Veo remains the default endpoint for both. Omni output always has audio; desired sound can only be described in the prompt. First/last frames cannot be combined with reference images, and a last frame cannot be used alone. Manually added names containing `gemini-omni`, including `gemini-omni-1.2-*`, are prefilled with the Omni endpoint. Custom providers can also choose "Gemini Video (Omni)", using an API Key for an Interactions API-compatible service and overriding submit and poll paths separately; the Vertex AI version remains exclusive to built-in providers. Sora 1080p support follows the catalog entry's resolutions, not `pro` in the model name.

Kling video has two request formats. The legacy API names the model in parameters, with four endpoints distinguished by last-frame and audio request conventions. The new API puts the model name in the request path, using "Kling Video (New API, always with audio)" for models offered only through it, such as kling-4.0, kling-4.0-flash, and kling-3.0-turbo. The new API accepts only API Key authentication; a built-in Kling configuration with only Access Key and Secret Key cannot use it. Output always has audio, without an audio switch; current support covers text-to-video and first/last frames, not reference images or reference video. Adding models with these names prefills this endpoint.

If someone has already adapted the call endpoint you need, you can install it directly from the [Market](./market.md) instead of writing the definition yourself.

pairs.source_Chinese: 只有火山方舟与 BytePlus 的 Seedance 2.0 与 2.5 系列模型的参考图使用素材引用。是否适用看模型挂接的调用端点，不看模型 ID 本身：调用端点为「火山方舟 (Seedance 2.0)」或「火山方舟 (Seedance 2.5)」时适用，「火山方舟 (Seedance 1.x)」不适用。内置供应商与自定义供应商的模型按同一规则判断。首帧、尾帧、分镜图与图片生成仍然发送图片内容。切换推理凭证后，按新凭证的绑定重新判断，之前账号里的关联不再适用。
pairs.before_English: Only reference images for the Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 model series on Volcano Engine Ark and BytePlus use asset references. Whether a model belongs to these series depends on the model it maps to in the model catalog, not on the model ID itself: this also applies to custom provider models that use the **Volcengine Ark (Seedance)** call endpoint and either match Seedance 2.0 or 2.5 by name or are linked to one with **Link to another model** in the model information. A model that does not map to the model catalog sends image content as usual, even if its ID contains the word Seedance. First frames, last frames, storyboard images, and image generation still send image content. After switching the inference credential, ArcReel decides again based on the new credential's binding, and links in the previous account no longer apply.
pairs.after_English: Only reference images for the Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 model series on Volcengine Ark and BytePlus use asset references. Eligibility follows the model's call endpoint, not the model ID itself: "Volcengine Ark (Seedance 2.0)" and "Volcengine Ark (Seedance 2.5)" are eligible; "Volcengine Ark (Seedance 1.x)" is not. Built-in and custom provider models follow the same rule. First frames, last frames, storyboard images, and image generation still send image content. After switching the inference credential, ArcReel reevaluates against the new credential's binding; links under the previous account no longer apply.
